Class H3BufferAndEventCoordinator

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.core.H3BufferAndEventCoordinator
public final class H3BufferAndEventCoordinator extends Object

H3BufferAndEventCoordinator

Coordinates Data-Oriented Design (DOD) buffer synchronization (WorldBuffer $\leftrightarrow$ H3Cell and AgentBuffer), scenario-scheduled climate/cataclysm event impacts, political seeding, and historical world snapshot restoration for H3SimulationEngine.
Extracted from H3SimulationEngine to enforce the Single Responsibility Principle.

Version:
1.0.0-beta.2
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
